name: Jwala Vihar–Saran Nagar National Highway
significance: NH 125A is a branch of NH 125. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Jwala Vihar to Saran Nagar, and it meets NH 125 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 125 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Pokaran to Paota
